qa.what_happened: I felt a growing sense of dread as the warnings mounted. Each officer seemed to escalate their warnings, and the constant threat of punishment in the hole weighed heavily on me. I was starting to feel that I was just going through the motions, and the only thing keeping me from breaking down was the fear of the consequences.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 1969, experiencing the heightened tension and fear during the study.

qa.what_happened: 9969 continued to push the limits, especially during the work detail and at lights out, despite multiple verbal warnings. Tensions are high, and I'm starting to feel the strain of constantly dealing with their non-compliance.
